annotations.text:
ONE canonical Convex catalog drives everything.
Customer matrix and Catalog QA are the same family structure and the same rows — QA only exposes extra diagnostics. No separate matrixProducts dataset.

Customer surface stays: Bottle → Size → Finish → Component → Qty.
Variant resolution, fitment (17-415 / 18-415 / roller / stopper), compatibility and validation all happen server-side. Fitment shows only as secondary text.

The picker is a real picker (P0): it only ever receives server-resolved compatible components. Precedence: exclusion > inclusion > exact fitment > family inference. Unknown ≠ compatible. Bottle Only is explicit, never implied.

DECIDED 2026-08-31 (Jordan):
• No Request Quote — people buy or they don't. Questions route to Grace instead. Revisit later.
• Order minimum is $50 per ORDER, not a per-SKU MOQ — so the MOQ column is gone and the minimum lives in the order bar.
• Catalog QA scans the FULL catalog.

TAX GATE — see the onboarding artboard below.
Anyone may purchase; buying UNTAXED requires a resale certificate approved by a Best Bottles employee. Today only a bare taxExempt boolean exists on portalAccounts — no document, no approver, no expiry, and checkout attaches no Shopify customer, so exemption cannot yet be applied.

Sample content uses real catalog grammar: GB-CYL-AMB-9ML SKUs, real finishes (Clear · Amber · Cobalt · Frosted · Swirl), real trims, real prices (the $0.69 12+ step exists in the catalog but is not displayed — see the volume note). Family list must be derived from Convex at build time — never from this mockup. Bracketed values are placeholders for real records.

VOLUME PRICING — resolved mechanism, not an open question.
src/lib/volumePricing.ts already ships resolveChargedUnitPrice() vs resolveQuotedUnitPrice() behind VOLUME_TIERS_HONORED_AT_CHECKOUT (default off, because Shopify charges the flat variant price — proven in production: a box advertised $0.23/ea at 10+ checked out at $0.35). So the matrix shows ONE price, from resolveChargedUnitPrice. The 12+ ladder returns automatically when Shopify volume rules are configured and scripts/audit_price_parity.mjs passes.
Mobile reuses the configuration engine as sequential steps — the matrix itself is desktop-first (≥1280px). No fake status bar: real device chrome renders above this layout.
